chapters.label: Live at Old Trafford
chapters.text: Old Trafford, 2024: Manchester United against Liverpool. A United pass goes astray, and Liverpool break fast. Gravenberch finds Salah on the right. Salah crosses to the far post, and Díaz heads it in. Goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. The pass comes loose, and Gravenberch finds Salah in a flash. Nobody marks the far post, and Díaz heads it home.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How he does it: win the ball, look up, and spot the open grass. Carry it forward, fast. Defenders must back away. After you win it, run into the space in front!
